name: UFortGameplayAbility__GetProjectileAimDirection
inc_or_decl:
// Direction toward the homing target, or a fallback from the owning pawn cached transform (+0x1c0 rotation, +0x1d0 location) when no target. Caller passes the stored 0x8b1 flag as the first argument. LOW: only the first 40 lines were read; the third native argument is a constant 0 at the call site and is dropped.
FVector GetProjectileAimDirection(bool bUseStoredAimFlag, bool bApplyInaccuracy) const;
